`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0]         input_unencoded,
    output wire                     output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0]         output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_allow;
        wire [3:0] group_code;
        wire [15:0] low_terms [3:0];

        priority_encoder_msb16_parallel group_encoder (
            .data(group_valid),
            .valid(output_valid),
            .allow(group_allow),
            .encoded(group_code)
        );

        genvar g, j, b;
        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] local_allow;
            wire [3:0] local_code;

            priority_encoder_msb16_parallel local_encoder (
                .data(input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16]),
                .valid(group_valid[g]),
                .allow(local_allow),
                .encoded(local_code)
            );

            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : code_terms
                assign low_terms[b][g] = group_allow[g] & local_code[b];
            end

            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : winners
                if (g*16+j != 0) begin : nonzero_bit
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] =
                        input_unencoded[g*16+j] & local_allow[j] & group_allow[g];
                end
            end
        end

        assign output_encoded[7:4] = group_code;
        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : low_code
            assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
        end

        // The original decoder selects bit zero even when the input is zero.
        assign output_unencoded[0] = ~(|input_unencoded[255:1]);

    end else begin : original_general
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];

        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end

        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

// allow[k] is true exactly when all data bits above k are zero.
// encoded is the highest asserted index, or zero for an empty input.
module priority_encoder_msb16_parallel (
    input  wire [15:0] data,
    output wire        valid,
    output wire [15:0] allow,
    output wire [3:0]  encoded
);
    wire [3:0] nibble_valid;
    wire [3:0] nibble_allow;
    wire [3:0] bit1_terms;
    wire [3:0] bit0_terms;

    assign nibble_allow[3] = 1'b1;
    assign nibble_allow[2] = ~nibble_valid[3];
    assign nibble_allow[1] = ~(|nibble_valid[3:2]);
    assign nibble_allow[0] = ~(|nibble_valid[3:1]);

    genvar n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 4; n = n + 1) begin : nibbles
            assign nibble_valid[n] = |data[n*4 +: 4];

            assign allow[n*4+3] = nibble_allow[n];
            assign allow[n*4+2] = nibble_allow[n] & ~data[n*4+3];
            assign allow[n*4+1] = nibble_allow[n] & ~(|data[n*4+3:n*4+2]);
            assign allow[n*4]   = nibble_allow[n] & ~(|data[n*4+3:n*4+1]);

            assign bit1_terms[n] = nibble_allow[n] &
                (data[n*4+3] | data[n*4+2]);
            assign bit0_terms[n] = nibble_allow[n] &
                (data[n*4+3] | (~data[n*4+2] & data[n*4+1]));
        end
    endgenerate

    assign valid = |nibble_valid;
    assign encoded[3] = nibble_valid[3] | nibble_valid[2];
    assign encoded[2] = nibble_valid[3] | (nibble_valid[1] & ~nibble_valid[2]);
    assign encoded[1] = |bit1_terms;
    assign encoded[0] = |bit0_terms;
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline propagates encoded data through a binary priority-multiplexer tree and then decodes that encoded result to generate 256 one-hot outputs. This places priority selection and decoding in series, with substantial fanout on the encoded bits.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the requested instance into sixteen 16-bit groups. Four-bit subgroups produce parallel higher-priority exclusion masks and local codes. A second 16-way network handles group priority. Generate one-hot outputs directly from input bits and local/group exclusion masks, independently of the encoded-output path. Form the lower encoded bits by OR-reducing qualified local codes. Exclusion masks deliberately omit the current group's valid bit because local codes and winning input terms already vanish for empty groups. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by removing the serial encode-then-decode path and replacing cascaded encoded-data multiplexers with shallow grouped reductions. No mapped timing result is available; the gain and actual critical endpoint require evaluation in the specified flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds parallel exclusion-mask and local-code logic, while removing the global encoded-to-one-hot decoder from the specialized instance. Shared four-bit reductions limit duplication. Compliance with the 8862.124480 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations has not been measured and must be checked after mapping and sizing.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Pure combinational Verilog-2001 with unchanged module parameters, port widths, and unsigned interfaces. For WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, the highest asserted input index wins. An all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded with only bit zero asserted, matching the original. Multi-hot inputs are unrestricted. The specialization also checks LEVELS and W; other configurations use the original equations, including their truncation and default behavior. No assumptions, storage, clocks, latency, or external dependencies are introduced. Formal and mapped equivalence have not been run."
}
